content:
marco: Quick status loop for the Edge Sandbox cutover tomorrow — want a short async check on network / certs / registry / prober. Ping owners and blockers please.

sophia: On network: is the firewall rule for tenant subnet 10.40.0.0/22 approved and scoped to the right NAT gateways? @netops

netops: Rule created in staging and staged for prod push. ID: fw-6732. Will deploy 02:00 UTC tomorrow; tag sources as `tenant-789` and `edge-sandbox`.

ashwin: Certs update: I generated a CSR requiring SANs for `tenant-789.*`. Uploaded CSR to Vault path `secret/certs/tenant-789/csr.pem`. Awaiting signing from security. @rachel any ETA?

rachel: Signed and uploaded chain to the private bucket: s3://redwood-priv/certs/edge/tenant-789/chain.pem. Tested in staging. Fetch command:
```
curl -sS -o /tmp/chain.pem "https://s3.amazonaws.com/redwood-priv/certs/edge/tenant-789/chain.pem"
```

ops-bot: deploy-checker: image sync pending — airgap registry missing: `redwood/edge-runtime:1.4.2`. Run `registry-sync --tenant 789 --image edge-runtime:1.4.2` to push.

ashwin: On airgap: kicked off registry-sync at 12:10 PST, transfer ETA ~35m. If the sync fails we have a fallback flag `--allow-compat` to use compatible staging image. Will post result.

marco: Also: PR #4821 (mount /var/lib/edge changes) is green in CI but needs a second approval. @sophia can you take a quick look? It's a small error-handling nit.

sophia: Reviewing now. Found one minor edge-case when the mount path is missing, will push a single-line fix and merge.

rachel: Quick question — who owns the egress prober for tenant subnets? We saw intermittent DNS timeouts during canary runs this morning.

sre-oncall: that's me — I'll run the prober from tenant-789 subnet and paste logs. Quick smoke: `curl -I http://1.1.1.1` -> 200 OK, TTL fine. Running full 5m probe and will attach results.

marco: Owners summary for the cutover: netops (firewall), ashwin (registry sync), rachel (certs), sophia (code review), sre-oncall (prober). Please ack once your blocker is green so we can close the checklist. :thumbsup:

netops: ack — fw scheduled 02:00 UTC, CI for infra plan attached to the change.

ashwin: ack — registry sync complete at 1765562000, image `redwood/edge-runtime:1.4.2` present in airgap registry.

rachel: ack — cert chain uploaded and validated in staging. `openssl s_client -connect tenant-789.sandbox:443` returns full chain and correct CN.

sophia: ack — PR #4821 merged, CI passed, small fix pushed.

sre-oncall: ack but note: prober shows intermittent DNS 1/10 failures (short spikes). Filed INC-987 and added netops to the ticket. Will monitor during the next hour.

marco: Noted. If DNS flake doesn't stabilize we'll defer the cutover to the next window. For now keep the checklist open and post any new blockers here. Thanks all for the fast responses.
